subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs support a first-class job-level provider/model override, and if so which cron API surface owns that override?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but changes cron job schema, session-state/model-precedence semantics, and the boundary between text-only system events and model-backed agent turns; automation should not choose among those product/API shapes.

options.title: Approve explicit cron execution override
options.body: Add a canonical validated job-level provider/model override that works for `main + systemEvent` and other payload kinds without mutating session-store metadata.

options.title: Keep systemEvent model-less
options.body: Document that main-session system events only wake the main session and recommend isolated `agentTurn` for per-job model control once reliability is acceptable.

options.title: Reuse `payload.model` on systemEvent
options.body: Extend the existing payload field to system events, but require explicit heartbeat/session transport tests so it does not recreate the closed PR's context-key risk.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit cron execution override
recommendation.body: Add a canonical validated job-level provider/model override that works for `main + systemEvent` and other payload kinds without mutating session-store metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron protocol/service ownership and broad cron schema changes make this the best available product/API routing owner.
